name: TradingAgents
description: Simulates a trading firm with LLM agents in analyst, researcher, trader, and risk-manager roles that debate positions and converge on financial decisions.

skills.name: Role-Based Debate
skills.description: Runs bull and bear researcher agents against each other so a trade thesis is argued before any decision is made.

skills.name: Market Analysis
skills.description: Gathers fundamentals, sentiment, news, and technical indicators through dedicated analyst agents per data source.

skills.name: Risk Review
skills.description: Passes proposed trades through a risk-management agent that adjusts or vetoes positions before execution.
